diagnostics.consoleErrorsOptOutReason: The desktop host logs a window-branding notice at error level for a project without an embedded icon; that is host noise, not game behaviour.
diagnostics.networkErrorsOptOutReason: The desktop mailbox transport has no CDP network observer, so the browser-only network policy cannot be asserted here, and the web scenario playtests/float.playtest.json retains that check.

components.allowTrivial: The ocean's compute passes must actually dispatch: a SpectralOcean whose process() never runs holds whatever the warmup left in its cascade buffers, and the water is then a still photograph that every other assertion here passes on.
The sea under the hull must move: a spectral ocean whose compute passes never dispatch reads back the same height every frame, and every other assertion here still passes on a frozen sheet of water.
The drawn hull's design waterline sits on the sea surface; a hull riding above its own water is the failure this row exists to catch.
A negative age means the GPU height copy never landed, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.
